fields.summary: Support international characters: 你好世界 مرحبا العالم Здравствуй мир
fields.description:
## Unicode Test Cases

### Chinese Characters
你好世界 - Hello World

### Arabic Text
مرحبا بك في عالم البرمجة - Welcome to the programming world

### Russian Cyrillic
Привет мир программирования - Hello programming world

### Emoji Support
✅ Checkmark
🚀 Rocket
💡 Light bulb
🔧 Wrench

### Special Characters
- Math: ∑ ∏ ∫ √ ∞
- Currency: € ¥ £ ₹
- Symbols: © ® ™ ° § ¶

### Mixed Content
User story: 作为一个用户 (As a user), I want to see proper Unicode support 🌍
